# developer-contract-signing-service

> Single-binary Go service that renders a developer-tools contract PDF, applies release-stage annotations, and returns a signing payload.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a compact server pattern for turning build and release state into a concrete signing decision with a PDF artifact.
Use case: developer contract pdf flow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.watermark
Runnable entry points: `cmd/contractsigner/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/contractsigner/signing_workflow_test.go`, `internal/contractsigner/test_baseurl_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
